newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH STATE JAN-NOV TAX REVENUE UP 15 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH STATE JAN-NOV TAX REVENUE UP 15 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The Finnish state's tax and tax-related revenues increased 15.0 percent year-on-year in January-November to 112.43 billion markka, the finance ministry said in a statement received on Tuesday.
Total state revenue excluding borrowing increased 17.5 percent to 158.83 billion markka.
State expenditure excluding debt amortisation fell 2.9 percent year-on-year to 187.32 billion markka.
The central government's net borrowing requirement was 28.50 billion markka in January-November, down from 57.61 billion in the corresponding period in 1995, the ministry said.
